title: Meridian plan, version 2
description: A compiled run, as plan.Encode writes it: everything a coordinator needs to schedule the run, and a worker to run its jobs. Its $defs describe the plan's other types too, which readyjob.schema.json, record.schema.json, runvalues.schema.json and jobresult.schema.json name, and the stored values and expressions every one of them holds. Every member is described; a member this version doesn't have is refused, as plan.Decode refuses it. Whole numbers are written without a fraction or an exponent, as 2 and never 2.0, 2e0 or -0.0, which decoding refuses though JSON Schema can't tell them from integers; each integer's bounds are its Go type's, as a Go int has 32 bits on some systems.

version.description: The plan encoding's version: a plan is written at the lowest that holds what it uses, so one without calls is of version 1, which version 1's schema describes.

jobs.description: The run's jobs, each once, in the order of their names.

warnings.description: The compiler's warnings, kept with the run so that they reach whoever runs the workflow.

calls.description: The pins of the workflows that the workflows the run's own steps call call in turn, down the tree, each by the digest of the text of the workflow whose step names it and the step's JSON Pointer in that text, in the order of the two, each once. Version 2.

checkouts.description: The pins of the parallelworks/checkout steps of the workflows the run calls, down the tree, each by the digest of its workflow's text and the step's JSON Pointer in it, in the order of the two, each once. Version 2.

Call.description: The pin of the workflow that a step of a workflow the run calls names.

caller.description: The digest of the text of the workflow whose step it is.

step.description: The step's JSON Pointer in that text, as /jobs/build/steps/0.

source.description: The workflow the step names, pinned, by its reference as the step writes it.

CheckoutPin.description: The pin of a parallelworks/checkout step of a workflow the run calls. Version 2.

caller.description: The digest of the text of the workflow whose step it is.

step.description: The step's JSON Pointer in that text, as /jobs/build/steps/0.

Checkout.description: A parallelworks/checkout step's repository and revision, as its with: writes them out, pinned to the commit the revision named as the run was created. Version 2.

repo.description: The repository's URL, as with: repo writes it: https or ssh, or scp-like, with no credential in it.

revision.description: The branch, tag or commit with: branch names.

commit.description: The commit the revision named, in full, as git writes it.

Run.description: What the plan holds about the run as a whole.

release.description: The Meridian release that compiled the plan, as v1.2.3, or (devel) for a build of Meridian that isn't one. It says which build made the plan, and isn't part of what the plan is: the plan's digest leaves it out.

inputs.description: The run's input values that read no variable and no password, with defaults applied and ignored inputs left out: a mapping.

definitions.description: The workflow's input definitions, on.execute.inputs, with their expressions parsed, but for what withheld names.

withheld.description: The JSON Pointers, in the workflow, of the parts of the input definitions that definitions leaves out, as they can hold a password.

decisions.description: The JSON Pointers, in the workflow, of the inputs' hidden, ignore and optional that read a variable or a password as the run was created, in order.

remote.description: The remote context, by name, as the run was created.

sessionNames.description: What the session provider gave for each session as the run was created.

secrets.description: The secret variables and the passwords the run reads, by name.

derived.description: The secrets, among secrets, that are values the run was given in the place of what is made from a password or a secret variable.

private.description: The values the run was given that the plan doesn't hold, though they aren't secrets, by name.

variables.description: The organization and user variables the run reads that aren't secrets, by name, in order: org or vars alone is all of the context.

treeVariables.description: The organization and user variables the workflows the run calls read, down its tree, by name, in order, which its Start reads once for the tree. Version 2.

parent.description: The step whose uses: names the run's workflow, for a child run, with what the run has of it that the plan holds. Version 2.

ParentRun.description: The step a child run runs the workflow of: a try of a step of a job of the run that called it, and what the child has of the step that its plan holds.

run.description: The ID of the run whose step calls this one.

job.description: The key of the step's job, an instance's for a matrix job, as in build#2.

step.description: The step's index in its job, from 0.

try.description: The step's try, from 0: each try of a step runs a child of its own.

root.description: The ID of the run at the top of the tree, which no step called, whose identity the run has.

depth.description: How far below its root the run is: 1 for a run that one of its root's own steps calls.

env.description: The calling step's environment, which the run's env: is laid over, by name, but for the variables that private and secrets name, which the run's secret record holds.

private.description: What the run was given of the step that the plan doesn't hold, made from an organization or user variable or a password, but no secret, in order: inputs. and a path for a part of the step's with:, and env. and a name for a variable of its environment.

secrets.description: What the run was given of the step that the plan doesn't hold, made from a secret, in order, named as private names it.

Limits.description: Meridian's limits on the run's size that the phases after Create apply. A member left out is the default.

maxInstances.description: How many instances a matrix can have.

Source.description: Where a workflow came from, and the exact text that ran.

location.description: Names the workflow to whoever can see the run.

revision.description: A Git commit, or sha256: and the SHA-256 digest of the text when no commit has it.

digest.description: sha256: and the SHA-256 digest of the text, for a workflow a step's uses: names.

remote.description: What the remote context of a run of the workflow holds, as the Sources resolver gave it when it pinned it, for one a step's uses: names. Version 2.

SourceRef.description: What a step's uses: names a workflow by.

uses.description: The step's uses: as it is written.

path.description: The workflow's file in the repository, the step's with: $yaml.

host.description: The Git server that holds the repository, the step's with: $host.

Job.description: One of the workflow's jobs. A matrix job is one job, whose instances are made from its strategy as the run goes.

name.description: The job's name in the workflow.

needs.description: The jobs this one waits for.

needsExpr.description: The job's needs:, when it is an expression that read a variable or a password as the run was created.

if.description: The job's if:. Left out means success(), and null is false.

path.description: The JSON Pointer of the job in the workflow.

Need.description: A dependency on a job: on every one of its instances, or, with any, on whichever finishes first.

Strategy.description: A matrix to expand once its values are known.

matrix.description: The strategy's matrix:, include and exclude among it.

JobRetry.description: A job's retry:, which runs the job again on another member.

if.description: The step's if:. Left out means success(), and null is false.

uses.description: A built-in action, or the workflow the step runs.

source.description: The workflow the step's uses: names, pinned as the run was created.

checkout.description: The pin of a parallelworks/checkout step: its repository and revision, pinned to a commit as the run was created. Version 2.

cleanup.description: The command the step's cleanup: runs at the end of its job.

path.description: The JSON Pointer of the step in the workflow.

cleanOnRetry.description: The step's clean-on-retry:. Left out means true, the format's default.

ReadyJob.description: A job as Ready evaluated it, as the worker runs it: an instance of a matrix job is one. It is encoded as a plan is.

key.description: The instance's key: the job's name, or for a matrix instance its name, # and index.

name.description: The job's name in the workflow.

matrix.description: The instance's matrix values, a mapping.

ifAlways.description: Set when the job's if: is the word always.

private.description: The contexts Ready gives the job that were made from a variable or a password, as matrix.

secrets.description: The contexts Ready gives the job that were made from a secret.

privateFields.description: The members above, by their JSON names, that Ready evaluated from a variable or a password.

secretFields.description: The members above, by their JSON names, that Ready evaluated from a secret.

masked.description: The strings Ready made from a secret, which the worker masks.

path.description: The JSON Pointer of the job in the workflow.

Target.description: Where a job runs, from its runs-on: or its format 1 ssh:: at most one member.

Inline.description: The execution group a format 1 ssh: makes, of one member.

Resources.description: CPUs, memory and GPUs, as a job's resources: asks for them. A member left out asks for none of it.

Environment.description: A platform's scheduler environment, which a format 1 runs-on: environment: names.

ComputeTarget.description: Where a job runs as a compute-target input gives it.

ReadyJobRetry.description: A job's retry: as Ready evaluated it.

Reason.description: Why an attempt ended other than by its own steps, or may run again.

Outcome.description: How a job or a step ended.

Record.description: A run's secret record: what the run needs that its plan and its run state can't hold. The coordinator keeps it encrypted.

version.description: The record encoding's version, the plan's.

planDigest.description: The digest of the plan the record was made with, as plan.Digest gives it: sha256: and the hex of the SHA-256 digest of the plan's encoding without its release.

submitted.description: What the run was submitted, a mapping, as it was given.

withheld.description: The parts of the input definitions the plan withholds, by their JSON Pointers.

decisions.description: What each of the plan's decisions decided as the run was created, by its JSON Pointer.

means.description: Each part of submitted that means the expression a form made it from, by name, with the expression's JSON Pointer in the workflow.

run.description: The private half of the run's values.

timeoutSeconds.description: The run's timeout, when evaluating it read a variable or a password.

expansions.description: The matrices whose instances are private, whole, by job name.

jobs.description: What each job, or matrix instance, kept private as it ended, by its key.

inherited.description: What a child run has of the step that calls it that its plan doesn't hold. Version 2.

stepRun.description: What a step run holds of the step's try it runs. Version 2.

Inherited.description: What a child run's secret record holds of the step that calls it.

env.description: The variables of the step's environment that the plan doesn't hold, which the plan's parent names, by name.

masked.description: The strings the step's worker masks, which the child's jobs mask too.

JobRecord.description: What the secret record holds of how a job ended.

Expansion.description: A matrix job's instances, and how the coordinator runs them.

Instance.description: One combination of a matrix's values.

matrix.description: Its matrix values, a mapping, or null where run state leaves out a private instance's.

RunValues.description: The run's values as Start completed them, which the phases after Start read.

JobResult.description: How a job ended, as its worker reports it.

private.description: The outputs that are private, by name.

secrets.description: The outputs that hold a secret, by name.

derived.description: The outputs, among secrets, only made from one, by name.

steps.description: The outputs of the job's steps that have ids, by id.

secretSteps.description: The outputs of the job's steps that hold a secret, by id.

derivedSteps.description: The outputs, among secretSteps', only made from one, by id.

Diagnostic.description: A problem, as foundation's problem.FieldError encodes it, without its text, which each reader renders in their own language from code and params.

Names.description: Values named by their paths, as plan.JoinPath writes them: a context, then the keys that lead to the value from there, a list's items by their indexes, joined with dots, a key's own . and ~ written ~1 and ~0, as in inputs.creds.0.pass. A context's name alone is all of it.

Keys.description: Keys of a mapping beside the list, by name.

StepRun.description: What a step run's secret record holds of the try of the step it runs on another host than its job's.

ssh.description: The step's ssh:, as the try evaluated it, which names the host the step runs on; absent for one that is null, or gives no remoteHost, in a job on a host.

private.description: Whether evaluating the step's ssh: read a variable or a password.

state.description: The state of the caller's job at the try, a mapping, as its worker gave it.

Data.description: JSON that is never evaluated, such as what a run was given: any JSON value, written as it is, a string with ${{ }} in it among them. Data that holds nothing is null where it is written: as a member that is always written, or an item; a member that is left out when it holds nothing is never null.

Value.description: Part of a workflow that may hold expressions: JSON values, in which each string with a ${{ }} in it is a template, an object whose one member is ${{. A mapping whose only key starts with $ is written inside an object whose one member is $, so that it is never taken for a template. So an object whose only key starts with $ is one of the two, and checked as it is, and any other value is checked as JSON values are, each value in it once.

Template.description: A string with expressions in it, as its parts: text, and expressions, one at least.

Expr.description: An expression: its source, kept for messages, and its parsed tree, which is what it means.

Node.description: A node of an expression's tree: an object, one of whose members names its kind, with the members a node of that kind has. Each member is checked once, against properties, and the members a kind has, by name, against allOf, so that a tree is checked in time linear in its size. Which contexts, operators and functions a tree can name, and the arguments each takes, are its format's, which can gain more without a new version: a release refuses one it doesn't know as a newer release's (plan.ErrVersion).

allOf.description: A literal that JSON has no number for.
A relative reference: up levels above the expression, then path.
An operator: a unary one, with x, or a binary one, with x and y, and negated, as !in is, with not.
The lambda that is the last argument of map() or filter().
A lambda's parameter, read in its body.
The operand (start):(end), whose end is null when it is left open.
The operand 2:(end): the word before the group, then the group's value.

Path.description: The segments of a path: a name, or a quoted key, a bare key, [index] or .*.
